summary: Token refresh endpoint returns 500 when session expired
details:
The /auth/refresh endpoint throws an unhandled error when the session has already been invalidated.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Login and obtain a session token
2. Wait for session to expire (or manually invalidate)
3. Call POST /auth/refresh with the expired token
4. Observe 500 instead of expected 401

context.error_log: TypeError: Cannot read property 'expiresAt' of null
